title: AI-Driven Digital Twin Framework for Warehouse Logistics Automation Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.38101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, warehouse logistics optimization has increasingly focused on intelligent, data-driven systems to enhance operational efficiency. Conventional static product placement strategies are being progressively replaced by dynamic slotting approaches that can adapt to real-time variations in warehouse conditions. In this work, we present a novel framework that employs a reinforcement learning agent integrated within a FlexSim-based Digital Twin environment for real-time product placement optimization. The proposed agent continuously learns from streaming operational data, enabling it to reduce picking time while improving overall system throughput. The simulation environment models a four-zone warehouse layout with forklift-based material handling and leverages the Asset Administration Shell framework to ensure seamless interaction between the learning agent, physical asset, and the digital twin. translated_title: 面向仓库物流自动化优化的人工智能驱动数字孪生框架
translated_abstract: 近年来，仓库物流优化日益聚焦于智能化、数据驱动的系统，以提升运营效率。传统的静态货品放置策略正逐步被能够适应仓库状况实时变化的动态货位优化方法所取代。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架在基于FlexSim的数字孪生环境中集成了强化学习智能体，用于实时货品放置优化。所提出的智能体能够从流式运营数据中持续学习，从而在降低拣货时间的同时提高系统整体吞吐量。该仿真环境对一个包含四个区域的仓库布局进行建模，采用基于叉车的物料搬运方式，并利用资产管理壳框架确保学习智能体、物理资产与数字孪生之间的无缝交互。实验评估结果表明……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将强化学习智能体集成于基于FlexSim的数字孪生环境的新框架，通过持续学习实时运营数据来优化仓库货品放置，从而减少拣货时间并提升系统整体吞吐量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates a reinforcement learning agent within a FlexSim-based Digital Twin environment, continuously learning from streaming operational data to optimize warehouse product placement, thereby reducing picking time and improving overall system throughput.
